comment: Class index <-> label for the classifier: the static letters of docs/alphabet.md. Dynamic letters are excluded because a single frame cannot distinguish them. There is no no_sign class: model-v1 had one and it failed (F1 0.06 on unseen signers), see experiments/models/no_sign_weighting.py; a hand that is not forming the target is a miss for the stabilizer instead.
excluded_no_sign: Bukva's no_event clips are extracted (letter = no_sign) but not trained on.
